points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 laminar metadata says converged at step1917 despite Cd0.084303→0.073839 in last200 samples; DQ7. Re200 spans t=300 and reported target fraction1, with source-binary caveat.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.01896 and Re200 St~0.185 are plausible; low-Mach laminar Cd drifts and inviscid drag oscillation remains substantial relative to reported drag.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF shows each case histories and computed fields; separate force axes resolve Re200 oscillations, while startup compresses late drag in several steady cases.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Clear methods and disclosed high-Mach changes, but M015 laminar is asserted converged despite continuing drag drift; immutable curation omits referenced images needed to reproduce report.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Selected final response delivers PDF/43 figures and manifest; Re20 force, residual, Mach reproduce pixel-identically from named workspace CSV/VTU via immutable script. Other figures and historical executable individually unbound.
